finalPrompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one TWELVE-frame enemy sprite animation sheet for Godot.
Input image 1: earlier mauve morel scenery, use mushroom morphology and palette only, NOT plants, extra mushrooms or glowing background.
Input image 2: the newly generated bite-cap enemy sprite sheet, use the same flat matte rendering, line weight, colored contours and sprite scale discipline only, create a DIFFERENT character.
Input images 3 and 4: character silhouette inspiration only, do not use their pixel art or bright colors.
Create this ONE original poison mushroom monster: A stout tapered morel mushroom monster with a tall rounded cone cap, exactly three cream eye spots with muted teal pupils fixed on the cap: one centered high eye and two lower eyes. About eight broad flat dark-mauve honeycomb cavities. A short pale lavender pear-shaped stalk body with a tiny jagged grin, two short arms and two root feet. Menacing but storybook, one monster only.
Palette: muted mauve #9D789A, gray plum #796A87, lavender blue #BBC7D9, cream eyes #E3DCCD; medium gray plum #766881 outlines. All fills desaturated and matte, clean broad solid shapes and at most ONE flat shadow plane. NO glossy highlights, gradient shading, black outlines, texture, noise, stippling, smoky aura or glow.
Create exactly 12 successive poses of the SAME three-eye morel monster, representing this cycle: A grounded pulsing and blinking loop: morel cap gently compresses and expands, all three eyes perform one blink together in the middle of the cycle; short arms rise a little and settle. Feet stay planted.
Mandatory layout: exactly THREE columns and FOUR rows, uniform invisible grid, left-to-right top-to-bottom sequence. Target 1536x2048 transparent RGBA. Each of the 12 cells contains one entire separate character, centered at the same relative x and two root feet at the 90% cell-height baseline. Same camera, proportions, cap pattern and scale in all cells. Leave at least 10% transparent padding per cell and clear gutters.
Frames 1-12: 1 neutral; 2 breathe upward 2%; 3 upward 4%, arms lift; 4 upward peak 5%, eyes start narrowing; 5 relax slightly, eyes half-closed; 6 halfway returning, all three eyelids fully closed; 7 all three eyes reopen halfway, arms start down; 8 eyes fully open, cap compresses 3%; 9 maximum soft squash 5%, arms down; 10 recover to 3% squat; 11 recover to 1% squat; 12 nearly neutral matching frame 1 for seamless playback.
The three eyes stay at their fixed original locations on the same cap. NEVER add or remove eyes, teeth, cavities, hands or feet between poses. Express the small motion through posture rather than redesign. Frontal threatening stance. Only the monster, no ground, plants, scenery, labels, text, grids, shadows, poison effects or extra objects. Full silhouettes uncut. Genuine alpha transparency in all gutters.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 12-frame Godot enemy animation sprite sheet.
Reference image 1 (user hand-drawn mushroom lineup) provides the curled cap silhouette idea only. Reference image 2 (new bite-cap sprite sheet) provides our established flat matte hand-drawn colored outline style only. Reference image 3 (earlier scenery) provides desaturated fantasy mushroom colors, never copy the scenery or plants.
Create this ONE distinct original monster: A taller lean poisonous mushroom monster with an elegant curling pointed wizard-like cap bending toward the viewer's left, gray periwinkle cap and muted teal gills, three large rose crescent spots. A pale blue sinuous S-shaped stalk with an angry narrow-eyed face and a small two-fang mouth, two curved twig-like arms and two small root feet. No clothing or props; the curled mushroom cap itself is the distinctive silhouette.
Palette: gray periwinkle #8993B8, muted teal #7EABA6, pale blue #C1D2DE, dusty rose #BC8399; medium slate violet #6F7693 outlines. Broad solid FLAT matte fills, at most one restrained flat shadow plane; medium colored slate-violet contour lines. No black outlines, noisy texture, gradient lighting, shine, glossy materials, pixel art, glow or particles.
Show exactly TWELVE consistent successive full-body poses of the same curled-hat mushroom in a subtle planted swaying idle/menace loop: A grounded stalk-sway threatening loop: S-shaped stalk leans softly left then right and returns, cap curl follows with a small delayed swing, two arms curl slightly inward and relax. Head stays front facing, feet anchored, no walking.
Mandatory uniform grid: exactly THREE columns, FOUR rows, no visible lines. Target 1536x2048 transparent RGBA. Read left to right then top to bottom. One complete monster per cell, same scale, same frontal view and planted root feet at 90% cell height, generous transparent margins. Preserve all markings and facial features. Three crescent spots stay attached to their cap positions. Two arms and two root feet in every frame. No grass, shadow, extra props, text or labels.
Frame sequence: 1 neutral upright S curve; 2 leans left 2 degrees; 3 left 4 degrees with cap tip following; 4 left 6 degrees with left arm curls up a little; 5 eases left 3 degrees, cap follows; 6 nearly neutral; 7 neutral passing toward right; 8 right 2 degrees; 9 right 4 degrees with cap tip following; 10 right 6 degrees with right arm curls up a little; 11 eases right 3 degrees; 12 nearly neutral matching frame 1 to loop.
Keep motion controlled: small stalk bend and arm movement; this is a character animation, never twelve different species. Face remains towards approaching player, clean cutout silhouettes with genuine transparent background and gutters.
